description: Snapshot of the whole Cardano DEX market: ADA price (USD), 24 h volume and total value locked (ADA and USD), trade count, volume share per DEX (percent), and the top gainers, losers and trending (most traded by 24 h volume) tokens. Use it for "how is the Cardano market doing" questions and to check how fresh the data is (`sync.lagSeconds`).
name: get_market_overview
title: Cardano DEX market overview
